headline: Oil plunges on Iran peace hopes while silver rebounds
paragraphs: Crude oil prices tumbled sharply today, with Brent plunging 10.97% to EUR 93.60 per barrel and WTI dropping 7.21% to EUR 86.33. The retreat was driven by growing market optimism surrounding a potential breakthrough to end the Iran conflict and hopes for further diplomatic talks.

Palladium fell 3.06% to EUR 852.94 per ounce, though the specific catalyst behind today's decline remains unclear from market reports. Meanwhile, silver bounced back 1.83% to EUR 44.68 per ounce, trimming steep weekly losses as the sharp slump in oil prices helped ease broader interest rate hike fears.

Natural gas slipped 0.38% on the day to EUR 2.58 per MMBtu, but remains up 7.04% over the week amid European inventory concerns after Germany missed its gas storage targets. For Irish businesses, the dramatic easing in crude markets offers immediate potential relief on fuel, freight, and energy overheads.
